patches.value: Fix r>0, J=[r/2,3r/2], and choose compact C from H003. For every s∈J, u(·,s)=q off C. Smoothness implies derivatives vanish there, so e and e_t are continuous and supported in C. M001 applies to e, giving integrability and making E the ordinary finite integral. C×J is compact by M005; M004 gives uniform continuity of e_t on it. Applying M006 with F(τ)(x)=e(x,τ) and F′(τ)(x)=e_t(x,τ), the compact support, measurability, integrable base function, integrable majorant, and pointwise derivative conditions established here give E′(r)=∫e_t. The independently exported N001 and N002 state these support/integrability and differentiation conclusions for every positive time.

For each j set g_j=u_t·u_{x_j}. Its spatial derivative is continuous and compactly supported, so M001 gives integrability. Apply M007 on each coordinate line with second factor 1; the endpoint values of g_j vanish, hence ∫∂_j g_j=0. Product integrability and S-finiteness permit M003 to identify the whole-space integral with the iterated line integral. Expanding ∂_j g_j and summing gives E′(r)=2∫u_t·(u_{tt}−Δ_xu), precisely N003. Differentiating H001 yields u·u_t=0; H002 gives u_{tt}−Δ_xu=a u, so the integrand vanishes pointwise, as exported in N004. Therefore E′(r)=0. The Euclidean vector dot products and Frobenius sum have exactly the stated componentwise meanings, and no regularity of a is used.
